headline: Terry Matalas shares surprising VisionQuest pitch
post:
The Disney+ series VisionQuest is reaching its finale next week, concluding the Wanda Maximoff trilogy that began with WandaVision and continued with Agatha All Along. headline: VisionQuest alters early MCU hero history
post:
Hey Marvel family! Have you been keeping up with the latest episodes on Disney+? According to Screen Rant, the MCU has reportedly rewritten a major piece of lore right before the release of Avengers: Doomsday and the return of Chris Evans as Steve Rogers. 🎬

In VisionQuest episode 7, a flashback to 1939 introduces JIM, also known as the Synthetic Man. Played by Paul Bettany, Doctor Phineas T. Horton's creation was confirmed to be a "hero of his time who saved lives". This timeline actually predates Steve Rogers receiving the Super Soldier serum in 1943, challenging who we think of as the earliest hero.

While JIM's systems eventually overheated and led to his destruction, his origin goes all the way back to the same year Marvel Comics #1 was published. It makes you wonder how these early timelines might connect.

Do you think JIM and Steve Rogers ever crossed paths back in the day?

#VisionQuest #MarvelStudios #CaptainAmerica
original_title: Marvel Officially Retcons Chris Evans' Captain America Origin Before Avengers: Doomsday

headline: Captain Marvel and Daredevil share unexpected kiss
post:
Hey everyone! Things are getting pretty wild in Marvel Comics right now. According to Screen Rant, an unexpected romance has officially begun between two major Earth's Mightiest Heroes.

Following the events of Marvel's Armageddon, Captain Marvel recently lost a huge portion of her powers and the ability to fly. While drowning her sorrows at Josie's Bar in Hell's Kitchen, Matt Murdock shows up to check on her. After some conversation, the two heroes lean in for a sudden kiss. They are quickly interrupted by Daredevil's enhanced senses, but the issue makes it very clear that they are interested in pursuing something special together.

This pairing brings together a cosmic powerhouse and a street-level vigilante. However, Matt has a notoriously difficult romantic track record, and Carol is currently navigating a very vulnerable mindset. Adding this kind of workplace drama to the current Avengers lineup could spell absolute chaos for the team. What do you think about this surprising new comic book couple?

#CaptainMarvel #Daredevil #Avengers
original_title: Avengers' Worst Romance Of All Time Just Officially Began
